method: search_news 24h max_results=10; get_posts_counts_recent 24h (day granularity, from 2026-10-11T01:07Z; total_tweet_count)

filter_note.note: Sunday of NFL Week 5 games (stamped vibe week reg-6 per weeks.json). Shared X access threw repeated 429s; news pulls completed for all 32 clubs, but post-count volume only landed for 16 clubs (ARI through KC) before throttling, so the other 16 have volume null and loud-room ranking is partial. Loudest measured rooms: GB and CHI (31-7 rout, Mack reunion talk, Ditka death), ARI (Harrison traded to HOU), JAX (London walk-off over PHI), DET, HOU, CLE, BAL. Status-heavy: Lamar out (Huntley started SNF), Bills without Palmer/Oliver with DJ Moore questionable for MNF, Pittman IR, Dowdle unlikely, Deebo Samuel injured, Trey Lance IR, Slater/Alt/James out, Jefferson active/Addison out, Chase/Higgins active, Jeanty active, Eagles without Barkley/Smith/Brown/Greenard, Thornton/Rice hurt (KC hosting Justin Watson). CAR and TB fully quiet (both rooms only returned other clubs' stories). Dropped mostly college football (Red River, Tennessee-Arkansas, Boise State, BYU-Notre Dame), NHL/NBA/MLB/F1/IMSA, Packers alternate uniforms, Patriots 2001 throwback nostalgia, all-time-team and Brady memes, parlay/fantasy posts, GTA VI stadium ads, coach and lineman memes, and cross-club near-dupes.
